rule_outs: Dwelling 2 m from the best section
summary: Short kerb by driveways and bus zone, with homes 2-5 m away.
reasons: Dwellings 2 m and 5 m from kerb

drivers.seclusion: Homes at 2 m (at 17 m and 40 m) and 5 m (at 12 m) sit right behind the kerb; the next is 12 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Short 50 m stretch winding round driveway entrances; a van would block them.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a bus stop at this stretch.
drivers.convention: Bus zone signs and St Lucia traffic area restriction (Mon-Fri 7am-6pm); few cars parked.

sun_shade: Heavily shaded by trees on the north side; open to the south.

best_section.where: Hawken Drive kerb on the bend just past the driveway entrances
